_comment: `amendments` holds requirement-id references ONLY — ["A1", "A2"] — and nothing else. The
records themselves live in the phase's amendments.json; a verdict then reads 'verified at
attempt N, plus amendments A1..An'. It is the one schema extension since the schema was frozen,
made at the schema (skills/verifier-triage) rather than as a bespoke top-level key.
`execution` replaced `test_quality`, at the schema, for the same reason: `test_quality.reviewed`
was a boolean the verifying agent wrote about itself and every gate believed. `chain` is the
head of the hash chain over verification-evidence.json's recorded runs; the gates refuse a pass
whose chain does not match the transcript on disk. `run` no longer carries a family comparison:
the cross-family reading pass it described is gone, and a field asserting an independence
nothing performs reads as coverage that is not there.
`method` on every finding is the third extension, at the schema (issue #96): how the finding was
established and how its fix is confirmed - what was DRIVEN, over which axes. A sweep done by
reading reported complete and missed two instances; a probe that drove one axis of two scoped a
fix round that closed half a defect. scripts/verifier_precheck.py refuses a finding without it.
A finding's `status` has a fourth value, `deferred`, with `deferred_to` naming the owning phase
(issue #115). It resolves the finding ONLY when the phase's carried.json records a deferral
naming it - `scripts/carried_items.py defer`, gated on the phase's structured Done when and
carrying the measurement. The stamp alone is an open finding; `bypassed` stays false, since a

superseded_attempts.outcome: <one line — the attempt itself is archived, never nested here>

report: <= 1500 chars: the headline judgement, plus only what the structured fields cannot say>

execution.chain: <scripts/verifier_evidence.py chain <phase-dir> — the transcript this verdict stands on>

findings.instruction: <concrete fix directions for the routed agent>
findings.method: <how this was established and how its fix is confirmed: what was DRIVEN, over which axes - never 'read'>
